# /fc:scout

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/scout.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/scout.md instead. -->

> **Shortcut.** Runs [`/fc:explore`](explore.md) under a shorter name.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:scout` |
| Codex name | `$fc-scout` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/explore.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Shortcut for /fc:explore — Explore a feature request — read the code, present 2–4 implementation approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation, before any spec |
| Arguments | `<feature request>` |

## Usage

**Shortcut.** `/fc:scout` is a shorter name for [`/fc:explore`](explore.md): the same task, not a
deprecated one. It runs the explore task with the same input, takes the same arguments, and writes
what `/fc:explore` writes. It shows no notice. Codex has `$fc-scout`, and headless `TASK=scout`
runs the explore task too. To pin a model, map `explore` in `ai-factory/models.yaml`.
